weeks.bio: DJ Shakti Rising, aka Sitara, born & raised in NE Portland, Oregon, birthed and produced the wonderful Unity Ecstatic Dance Ashland for 4.5 years, an amazing era of next generation Ecstatic Dance in Ashland OR. Sitara has been a dancer since she can remember & has been devoted to music and dance for the last 35+ years. She has been in the worldwide network of Ecstatic Dance for over 18 years, a foundational practice for her self care, channeling energy in a healthy way, personal growth, transformations, joy and building community.

weeks.somaticBlurb:
BodyHeart Enchantress Carolyn Candela leads the SomaLab this week.
Her caring, loving dance-altar craftations have been deepening our vessel’s spirit and now we get to experience her yogaTeach.

Heart Opening Yoga & Intuitive Dance

“Soften your body. Open your heart. Let yourself move.

In this gentle, nourishing movement journey, we’ll explore the connection between the heart and body through slow, melty yoga, conscious breath, and intuitive movement.

Beginning with grounding and heart-opening postures, we’ll invite the body to release its armor and soften into sensation. From this place of openness, we’ll transition into an intuitive dance exploration, allowing movement to arise organically rather than from the thinking mind.

Let this be an invitation to surrender, feel, play, and let your heart lead the way.”
-Carolyn

Our weekly eDance offers a facilitated movement experience called Soma Lab.
It’s included in the regular cost of entry.
Each Week:
7-7:45pm Soma Lab
8-10pm Ecstatic Dance
All together $22-18 Sliding Scale Payment
